title: chat-filenode: chatspace root role can be set/cleared by update
description: Pre-existing (applied equally to the old urn role). Root invariants (spaceId present, one root per Space, manage_space to create) are checked only on FileNode/set create; upstream role is mutable, so an update can set role chatspace on any Directory (no spaceId) or clear it (second root becomes creatable, discovery returns nothing). Proposed fix: role chatspace can be set only at creation; server rejects updates changing role to/from chatspace with invalidProperties naming role. Found by verify workflow wf_e2550798-ffd.
close_reason: chatspace role settable only at create; updates changing role to/from chatspace rejected with invalidProperties
